request.description: Creates a new donation record, allocates a sequential 80G receipt number (e.g. ISLAH/RCPT/2026-27/000001), links to patient case if provided, and adds to verification registry.
Fetches a specific donation and 80G receipt by its unique receipt number.
Registers a new member under Community (₹2,500), Contributing (₹4,000), or Patron (₹6,000) tiers, auto-generates Member ID (e.g. ISLAH-CM-2026-001) and adds to Document Verification registry.
Verifies membership status (Active vs. Expired), validity dates, tier, and member profile.
Retrieves members list filtered by category, state, active status, or search query.
Returns active emergency medical patient cases, needed amounts, raised funds, and current conditions.
Returns full clinical breakdown, hospital address, admission dates, cost breakdowns, and verification IDs.
